task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights query result and extract all unique log levels (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG) from a list of log entries
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly identify and match all AWS log level indicators in CloudWatch log entries, ignoring case sensitivity and handling log entries with varying formats

task: Create a Python function that takes an AWS S3 object key path and returns a formatted CloudFront URL, given a CloudFront distribution domain name as a parameter
solution_criteria: The function should correctly format the URL, handle leading slashes in the S3 key, and return a valid CloudFront URL (https://domain/path/to/object)

task: Generate a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy statement allowing read-only access to a specific S3 bucket and all objects within it
solution_criteria: The JSON must be valid IAM policy syntax, include appropriate Actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket), Resources, and Effect set to 'Allow'
